svg.title: OrientMatch pipeline
svg.desc: Building a Matcher precomputes the template orientation field, its square rotation canvas and a bank of coarse rotated copies. Each frame is converted to an orientation field, scanned globally at a sparse set of angles, and the best separated places are then refined locally - first over the skipped angles, then at full resolution.
svg.text: what is paid for once, and what happens on every frame
120 angles at 0.5× — reused for every frame
one pose per place, best first
MatchResult: center (x, y) · angle θ · score
the precomputed 0.5× bank is what both 0.5× stages slide
the full-resolution canvas is rotated on demand, one fine angle at a time
Each stage transforms its image window once, then correlates every angle against it. Fixed scale; matchAll() reports every place.
